title: Asset blocked
description: This event occurs when an asset is blocked.

asset_block_id.title: Asset block ID
asset_block_id.description: Unique asset block identifier. Generated by Pismo platform.

asset_id.title: Asset ID
asset_id.description: Unique asset identifier defined by client. This is part of the asset identifier on the Pismo platform. It can be used to make redemptions and cancellations.

issuer_id.title: Issuer ID
issuer_id.description: Cetip code of registrator of asset. This is part of the asset identifier on the Pismo platform. It needs to be in every API call. An organization can have multiple issuer IDs.

status.title: Asset status
status.description: Whether asset is blocked or unblocked

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Reason asset was blocked or unblocked.

external_id.title: External ID
external_id.description: External identifier for operation. Optional field provided by customer in asset block operation.

units.title: Units
units.description: Number of units blocked or unblocked

created_at.title: Created date
created_at.description: Creation date of asset block operation on Pismo platform
